Log out of the component Market.

It does two things:
  1. Calls the Market's POST /auth/logout to revoke this token (the server side)
  2. Deletes .brickkit/credentials (the local side)

The local copy is always deleted, even when the Market is unreachable — otherwise a network blip would leave someone believing they have logged out
while the credentials still sit on disk. When the Market is unreachable it only warns, and says the token stays valid
until it expires.

When you aren't logged in it does nothing, and that isn't a failure.

Usage:
  brickkit logout [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit logout
  brickkit logout --keep-remote   delete only the local credentials, don't notify the Market

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for logout
      --keep-remote   Delete only the local credentials; don't call the Market to revoke the token (use when offline)

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
